Daṇḍin
7th Cent. poet an. rhetorician of Tamilnadu; native of Kāñcī, his ancestors having migrated from Gujarat to Kāñcī under the Pallavas; son of Vīradatta an. Gaurī, grandson of Manoratha an. great grandson of Dāmodara who was a friend of Bhāravi; a friend of the Kerala writer Māṭrdatta; lost his mother when he was seven an. his father when he was quite young.
Q. in Sarasvatīkaṇṭhābharaṇa an. in several anthologies. See also Smv. p. 45, verse 74; Madhurāvijaya verse 10 an. Bhojaprabandha.
On Daṇḍin an. his works, see V. Raghavan, Bhoja's Śṛṅgāraprakāśa (1963), p.. 836-39; also D. K. Gupta, A Critical Study of Daṇḍin an. his works, Mehrchand Lachhmandas, Delhi, 1970.
--Avantisundarīkathā.
For a detailed account of this work see NCC. I. Revised edn. p.. 418b-20.
Pt.. TSS. 172. [Page306-a.
--Kāvyādarśa or Kāvyalakṣaṇa.
Pt.. several times. See NCC. IV. p.. 107b-08b.
--Daśakumāracarita. prob. part of Avantisundarīkathā.
Pt.. N. S. Press. Bombay.
--Dvisandhānakāvya. narrating the story of Rāmāyaṇa an. Mahābhārata.
